_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. Pinned to commit SHAs, not a branch name, as of 0.1.9 -- a branch pin silently picks up whatever that branch's HEAD is at tag-push time, which twice produced a release missing work that had already been committed to the branch but not accounted for when the tag was cut. A SHA pin makes exactly what's bundled explicit and reviewable in this file's own diff. pine-lang unchanged since 0.37.1 (386948d). beamlynx-ui bumped to its merged 0.45.1 (connection-picker color/label fix, no more auto-popping-open the connection dialog, calmer notification bell) -- not yet in a tagged release of either -- switch to a real version tag once they are.
